failure_modes.mode: Coil blockage due to precipitate formation
failure_modes.cause: Low flow rate (0.2 mL/min) and long residence time (53 min) allow slow nucleation of salts or byproducts in laminar flow, exacerbated by potential local concentration gradients
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement online pressure monitoring with auto-shutdown at dP > 0.2 bar; add inline filter upstream; verify solubility of all species at 120°C

failure_modes.cause: Prolonged exposure of DMF to 120°C for 53 minutes may lead to hydrolysis or decomposition, generating toxic gases (dimethylamine) and altering reaction kinetics
failure_modes.mitigation: Conduct thermal stability study of DMF at 120°C for 60 min; install gas trap and scrubber downstream; monitor outlet for amine content

failure_modes.cause: Low flow rate (0.2 mL/min) with high-viscosity DMF at 120°C may cause inconsistent delivery or cavitation if inlet pressure is insufficient, leading to residence time distribution broadening
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurize feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above solvent vapour pressure; use positive displacement pump with low pulsation; validate flow consistency with tracer study

single_points_of_failure: Inline coil — blockage halts entire process
BPR valve — failure to relieve pressure could lead to overpressure if dP increases unexpectedly
validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at Q=0.2 mL/min and T=120°C for 60 min; monitor pressure stability and analyze outlet for decomposition products
Perform residence time distribution (RTD) study using a non-reactive tracer to confirm laminar flow profile and absence of channeling or dead zones
Simulate worst-case precipitate formation by spiking feed with 5% excess reagent; monitor pressure rise and coil integrity over 30 min
